name: calendar-applet
description: Find a time everyone is free. Static site for GitHub Pages backed by Firebase.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-calendar-applet "playwright test --trace off"
scripts.shots: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-calendar-applet "node tests/e2e/shots.mjs docs/shots"
scripts.test:published: SITE_ROOT=_site firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-calendar-applet "playwright test --trace off --project=desktop tests/e2e/flow.spec.js"
